args.body:
Hello,

I recently received an email from your team about your event organizing services, and I would like to take advantage of the free consultation you offer.

Could you please let me know the next steps to schedule a consultation? I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
